name: Gershon (Levi's son)
title: Ancestor of the Gershonites
summary: Gershon was the firstborn son of Levi, one of Jacob's twelve sons. He became the ancestor of the Gershonites, one of the three main branches of the Levites who were given special duties in the service of the tabernacle and later the temple.

keyEvents.title: Descent into Egypt
keyEvents.description: Gershon was among Jacob's descendants who moved to Egypt with his family during the famine in Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Levi's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Gershon is recorded as Levi's firstborn son in the official genealogies.

keyEvents.title: Counting of the Gershonites
keyEvents.description: The Gershonites, descendants of Gershon, were counted and registered in the wilderness under Moses' leadership.

keyEvents.title: Service at the tabernacle
keyEvents.description: The Gershonites were given responsibility for carrying and caring for the curtains, coverings, and screen of the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Levitical cities
keyEvents.description: The Gershonites were allotted thirteen cities in the promised land as part of the Levites' inheritance.
